description: Tomov site, MGH. MEGIN TRIUX, 102 magnetometers and 204 planar gradiometers, 1 kHz, 0.1-330 Hz hardware band. One participant, four 1-minute runs, recorded 2026-10-02.
_help: runs maps each condition to a file name in this directory. button_codes gives the STI101 bit values each button raises at this site; omit a key to use the design default. Add line_freq to override the mains frequency recorded in the file headers.
